definition: Generating 3D assets by optimizing a 3D representation so its renders satisfy a 2D diffusion prior (SDS), or increasingly by feed-forward 3D generators trained on 3D data.
details: Generating 3D assets by optimizing a 3D representation so its renders satisfy a 2D diffusion prior (SDS), or increasingly by feed-forward 3D generators trained on 3D data. The bridge between image-generation priors and usable game and design assets.
